scope: all F in GL2, commuting U, u acts F, v acts inverse F, vu=-detF*uv+detF*h2(U)

F_reflection.remaining_candidates: all divisible by negative F-eigenline y

F_noninvolution: normal cubic=f3+Luv; F(L)=detF*L and (1+Sym3F)f3=-detF*L*F(h); quotient by L makes F identity, so f3 divisible by L. L=0 gives a binary cubic, also reducible.
conclusion: all H3 cuts in this entire matrix/curvature family occur at F=-I and are exactly the recognized curved Clifford cuts
